issueOrPullRequest.title: bug: rich-text pastes render as raw HTML
issueOrPullRequest.body: The renderer drops everything after the first page of a paginated issue timeline, and the counts header still reports the full total, so the output reads as complete when it is not. Reproduced on three repos of different sizes; the cutoff is always exactly one hundred timeline items, which is the page size.

nodes.body:
Repro on two repos:

  • Timeline stops at page 2
  • Bot noise is counted as comments

Priority: P2 & P3 — happy to test a fix.

Plain markdown comment with an HTML repro snippet that must survive untouched: ```html
boom
``` The `style` attribute above is content, not paste formatting — padding this body well past the two-hundred-character detector floor so only the code-fence guard is protecting it.
